short_release_notes: Requires signed updater 1.0.102; use the complete Pi installer. Includes guarded restart-loop recovery, restored-anchor timeout and tone-tail corrections, durable failure history and scan activity evidence. Preserves identity, credentials, location, receiver settings and reporting choices. Exact installer installation, retry, reboot, check-ins and all configured windows qualified on the owned RTL bench. Live RF reporting and other receiver qualification remain separate.
